title: Reduce Your Claude Code Token Bill By 50%
description:
Comment "glass" for the CC Glass token tracker

You don't pay for what Claude says.

You pay for what you send it.

10 requests. 3,000 words back. Almost $12 gone.

The leak: one prompt loads 538 tools you forgot about.

CC Glass puts your token spend on a local dashboard. Works with Claude Code, Codex, more.

Install the repo. Run it. See the waste.

Then tell Claude to kill the tools you don't use.

Same work. Smaller bill.
